# Set Up

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gganimate)

# =============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATASETS
# =============================================================================
tracking_data <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/full_data.csv")
control_data  <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/field_control_data.csv")

# Compute vx and vy if they are missing
if (!all(c("vx", "vy") %in% names(tracking_data))) {
  tracking_data <- tracking_data %>%
    mutate(
      # Convert dir degrees to radians
      dir_rad = (dir * pi) / 180,
      vx = s * sin(dir_rad),
      vy = s * cos(dir_rad)
    )
}

```

# Identify Plays of Interest

```{r}

specific_game <- tracking_data %>%
  filter(possession_team == "IND", defensive_team == "LA", quarter == 3)

target_game_id <- 2023100106
target_play_id <- 2008

# Build the missing play_results list structure explicitly for the pipeline
play_results <- list(
  player_data = tracking_data %>% filter(game_id == target_game_id, play_id == target_play_id),
  surface_data = control_data %>% filter(game_id == target_game_id, play_id == target_play_id)
)

```

# Plot

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. DEFINE PLOTTING FUNCTION
# =============================================================================
# Function to plot a single, specific moment/frame
plot_nfl_pitch_control_moment <- function(play_results, target_frame = NULL) {
  
  player_df <- play_results$player_data %>%
    mutate(player_side = tolower(player_side)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_std) & !is.na(y_std))
  
  surface_df <- play_results$surface_data
  
  if (is.null(target_frame)) {
    if ("event" %in% names(player_df) && any(player_df$event %in% c("pass_arrived", "pass_outcome_caught"))) {
      target_frame <- player_df %>% 
        filter(event %in% c("pass_arrived", "pass_outcome_caught")) %>% 
        pull(frame_id) %>% 
        min()
    } else {
      target_frame <- median(unique(player_df$frame_id))
    }
  }
  
  player_snapshot <- player_df %>% filter(frame_id == target_frame)
  surface_snapshot <- surface_df %>% filter(frame_id == target_frame)
  
  # Target receiver identification
  if ("is_target" %in% names(player_snapshot)) {
    player_snapshot <- player_snapshot %>% mutate(is_target_flag = coalesce(is_target, 0) == 1)
  } else if ("player_role" %in% names(player_snapshot)) {
    player_snapshot <- player_snapshot %>% mutate(is_target_flag = player_role == "Targeted Receiver")
  } else {
    player_snapshot <- player_snapshot %>% mutate(is_target_flag = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Assign roles to player categories (Defense, Offense, Quarterback)
  player_snapshot <- player_snapshot %>%
    mutate(
      display_category = case_when(
        player_role == "Passer" ~ "Quarterback",
        player_side == "offense" ~ "Offense",
        player_side == "defense" ~ "Defense",
        TRUE ~ "Offense"
      )
    )
  
  # Ball Landing Marker Data Frame (for unified legend integration)
  ball_land <- player_snapshot %>%
    filter(!is.na(ball_land_x_std) & !is.na(ball_land_y_std)) %>%
    select(ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    slice(1)
  
  # Separation & Larger Label Box Placement
  target_row <- player_snapshot %>% filter(is_target_flag == TRUE) %>% slice(1)
  def_rows <- player_snapshot %>% filter(player_side == "defense")
  
  separation_df <- NULL
  if (nrow(target_row) > 0 && nrow(def_rows) > 0) {
    closest_def <- def_rows %>%
      mutate(dist = sqrt((x_std - target_row$x_std)^2 + (y_std - target_row$y_std)^2)) %>%
      slice_min(dist, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    
    separation_df <- data.frame(
      x_target = target_row$x_std,
      y_target = target_row$y_std,
      x_def = closest_def$x_std,
      y_def = closest_def$y_std,
      label_x = 105, # Shifted to bottom right corner
      label_y = 6,   # Above bottom field border
      dist_label = sprintf("Separation: %.1f yds", closest_def$dist)
    )
  }

  ymin <- 0; ymax <- 53.3
  xmin <- 0; xmax <- 120
  
  ggplot() +
    # Field Background
    annotate("rect", xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#1e7a3a") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 10, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#135c29") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 110, xmax = 120, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#135c29") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 5), color = "white", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 10), color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    # Pitch Control Heatmap Surface
    geom_tile(
      data = surface_snapshot,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = ppcf_att),
      width = 1, height = 1,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#1e40af", mid = "white", high = "#b91c1c",
      midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1),
      name = "Offense\nControl",
      na.value = "transparent"
    ) +
    
    # Ball Landing Spot (Layered point aesthetics mapped to Ball Landing legend item)
    {if (nrow(ball_land) > 0) list(
      geom_point(data = ball_land, aes(x = ball_land_x_std, y = ball_land_y_std), shape = 4, size = 5, stroke = 2, color = "black"),
      geom_point(data = ball_land, aes(x = ball_land_x_std, y = ball_land_y_std, color = "Ball Landing"), shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2, fill = "#eab308")
    )} +
    
    # Separation Line
    {if (!is.null(separation_df)) list(
      geom_segment(data = separation_df, aes(x = x_target, y = y_target, xend = x_def, yend = y_def), color = "#dc2626", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9)
    )} +
    
    # Velocity Vectors
    geom_segment(
      data = player_snapshot,
      aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, xend = x_std + vx * 0.5, yend = y_std + vy * 0.5, color = display_category),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Player Dots (Black border + colored core mapped to scale_color_manual)
    geom_point(data = player_snapshot, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std), size = 4.5, color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = player_snapshot, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, color = display_category), size = 3.2) +
    
    # Targeted Receiver Ring
    geom_point(
      data = player_snapshot %>% filter(is_target_flag == TRUE),
      aes(x = x_std, y = y_std),
      size = 6.5, color = "#dc2626", shape = 21, stroke = 1.5
    ) +
    
    # Larger Separation Tracker Box
    {if (!is.null(separation_df)) list(
      geom_label(
        data = separation_df, 
        aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = dist_label), 
        size = 4, 
        fill = "white", 
        color = "#dc2626", 
        fontface = "bold", 
        label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    )} +
    
    # Custom Color Scale Including Defense, Offense, Quarterback, and Ball Landing
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Defense" = "#3b82f6",
        "Offense" = "#facc15",
        "Quarterback" = "#10b981",
        "Ball Landing" = "#eab308"
      ),
      breaks = c("Offense", "Defense", "Quarterback", "Ball Landing"),
      name = "Key"
    ) +
    
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 120), ylim = c(0, 53.3)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Euclidean Distance Separation vs Pitch Control at Time of Pass",
      subtitle = "Rams @ Colts Week 4 3rd Quarter: Incomplete Pass Deep Left"
    )
}
# --- GENERATE STATIC PLOT ---

max_pre_pass_frame <- tracking_data %>%
  filter(phase == "pre_pass", game_id == target_game_id, play_id == target_play_id) %>%
  summarise(max_frame = max(frame_id, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_frame)

static_plot <- plot_nfl_pitch_control_moment(play_results, target_frame = max_pre_pass_frame)
print(static_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/Plots/field_control_raw_sep_example.png",
  plot = static_plot,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)


```
